```{r}

pacman::p_load(Seurat,
               SeuratDisk,
               dplyr,
               DoubletFinder,
               clustree,
               lisi,
               data.table,
               ggplot2,
               patchwork,
               RColorBrewer,
               ktplots,
               pheatmap,
               viridis)

basedir <- "~/Projects/Johnsen_group/scRNA_seq/pancreas_hsap/GEO_datasets_raw/hg38_aligned/mad_ccDiff_decontX_norm_May26"

# define function to automatically take PC cutoffs
pc_cutoff <- function(sobj) {
  # Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
  pct <- sobj[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(sobj[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
  # Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
  cumu <- cumsum(pct)
  # Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
  co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
  # Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
  # last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
  co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
  # Minimum of the two calculation
  pcs <- min(co1, co2)
  return(pcs)
}

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2e11)

```

### Read in datasets
```{r}

rdsfiles <- list.files(basedir, pattern = "RDS", full.names = T)

slist <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(rdsfiles))
names(slist) <- rdsfiles

for (i in names(slist)) {
  slist[[i]] <- readRDS(i)
}
names(slist) <- basename(names(slist)) %>% tstrsplit("_may26", keep = 1) %>% unlist()

```


```{r}

seu <- merge(slist[[1]], slist[-1])

seu[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu[["RNA"]])
seu[["RNA"]] <- split(seu[["RNA"]], f = seu$sample_id)

```


```{r}

seu <- seu %>% NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA()


pcs <- pc_cutoff(seu)

seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

res <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = res, algorithm = 4)

clustree(seu)

Idents(seu) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2" 

seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs, reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

#DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated_snn_0.2")
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated_snn_0.2", group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.2", raster = F)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated_snn_0.2", group.by = "Type", raster = F)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated_snn_0.2", group.by = "Project", raster = F)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated_snn_0.2", group.by = "sample_id", raster = F)

saveRDS(seu, file.path(basedir, "merged_projsplit_apr26.RDS"))

# LISI
emb_unintegrated_samp <- Embeddings(seu, reduction = "pca")
meta_proj <- data.frame(Project = seu$Project, row.names = colnames(seu))

lisi_unintegrated_proj <- compute_lisi(emb_unintegrated_samp, meta_proj, "Project")
median(lisi_unintegrated_proj$Project)
```


### scVI integration by Project

```{r}
library(SeuratWrappers)

Sys.unsetenv("PYTHONPATH")
library(reticulate)
use_python("/home/bou01pav/.conda/envs/scvi-env310/bin/python", required = TRUE)

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "6", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "6", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "6")

scvi <- import("scvi")
scvi$settings$dl_num_workers <- 7L
scvi$settings$num_threads <- 6L


seu <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = seu, method = scVIIntegration,
  new.reduction = "integrated.scvi_proj",
  conda_env = "~/.conda/envs/scvi-env310",
  group.by.vars = "Project"
)

pcs <- pc_cutoff(seu)


seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, reduction = "integrated.scvi_proj", dims = 1:pcs,
                     graph.name = "scvi_proj_snn")

res <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = res, algorithm = 4, graph.name = "scvi_proj_snn")

clustree(seu, prefix = "scvi_proj_snn_res.")

Idents(seu) <- "scvi_proj_snn_res.0.4"

seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction = "integrated.scvi_proj", dims = 1:pcs, reduction.name = "umap.scvi_proj")

DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap.scvi_proj", raster = F, group.by = "scvi_proj_snn_res.0.4") 
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap.scvi_proj", group.by = "Project", raster = F)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap.scvi_proj", group.by = "Type", raster = F)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap.scvi_proj", group.by = "sample_id", raster = F)


# LISI
emb_scvi_proj <- Embeddings(seu, reduction = "integrated.scvi_proj")

lisi_scvi_proj <- compute_lisi(emb_scvi_proj, meta_proj, "Project")
median(lisi_scvi_proj$Project)
```

### Harmony integration by Project

seu[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu[["RNA"]])
seu[["RNA"]] <- split(seu[["RNA"]], f = seu$Project)

  object = seu, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony_proj",

pcs <- pc_cutoff(seu)

# Score integrations

```{r}

# library(kBET)
# kbet_res <- kBET(emb, seu$Patient3)
# kbet_res$stats$mean_type

# silhouette metric
library(cluster, quietly = TRUE)

get_silhouette <- function (dataset, reduction, variable) {
  dist.matrix <- dist(x = Embeddings(object = dataset[[reduction]])[, dims])
  clusters <- dataset[[variable]]
  sil <- silhouette(x = as.numeric(x = as.factor(x = clusters)), dist = dist.matrix)
}

dataset$sil <- sil[, 3]

# mixing metric
max.k <- 300
mm <- max.k - MixingMetric(object = dataset, grouping.var = "replicate", reduction = reduction, dims = dims, max.k = max.k)
```

```{r}
PRJCA001063_annotated <- readRDS("~/Projects/Johnsen_group/spatial_transcriptomics/xenium/human_pancreas/GEO_datasets/scRNA/PRJCA001063/PRJCA001063_annotated.RDS")
PRJCA001063_annotated <- PRJCA001063_annotated %>% NormalizeData() %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA()

# Find transfer anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = PRJCA001063_annotated,    
  query = seu,          
  dims = 1:19,            
  reduction = "pcaproject",
  project.query = T)

# Transfer labels
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchors = anchors,           
  refdata = PRJCA001063_annotated$dblabel, 
  dims = 1:13                  # Dimensions to use for transferring
)

# Add predictions to the query dataset
seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = predictions)

Idents(seu) <- "seurat_clusters"  # or _nmi
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"

meta_c <- data.frame(predicted.id = seu$predicted.id, row.names=colnames(seu))
clisi_res <- compute_lisi(emb, meta_c, "predicted.id")


DimPlot(seu, group.by = "predicted.id", reduction = "umap.scvi2p.0.5")
```

```{r}
######## Ductal subclustering (Peng)
ductsub <- subset(seu_joined, subset = predicted.id == "pancreatic ductal cell") 
counts_matrix <- GetAssayData(seu_joined, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, colnames(ductsub)]
ductsub[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = counts_matrix)

ductsub <- ductsub %>% NormalizeData() %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% RunPCA()

#pcs <- pc_cutoff(ductsub)

ductsub <- FindNeighbors(ductsub, dims = 1:10, reduction = "integrated.scvi_patient3",
                         graph.name = "dsub")

res <- seq(0.1, 0.8, 0.1)
ductsub <- FindClusters(ductsub, resolution = res, algorithm = 4,
                        graph.name = "dsub")

clustree(ductsub, prefix = "dsub_res.")

Idents(ductsub) <- "dsub_res.0.2"
ductsub <- RunUMAP(ductsub, dims = 1:10, reduction = "integrated.scvi_patient3",
                   reduction.name = "dsub_umap")


pal3 <- DiscretePalette(17, 'polychrome')
DimPlot(ductsub, cols = pal3, reduction = "dsub_umap")

DotPlot(ductsub, features = c("Ductal1", "Ductal2", "Acinar", "PanIn", "Classical_CSY", "Basal_CSY"), 
        cols = "RdBu", group.by = "dsub_res.0.2")

FeaturePlot(ductsub, features = c("Classical_CSY", "Basal_CSY"), reduction = "dsub_umap",
            cols = c("lightgray", "red3"), min.cutoff = "q9", raster = F)

FeaturePlot(ductsub, features = c("Acinar", "Ductal1", "Ductal2", "PanIn"), reduction = "dsub_umap",
            cols = c("lightgray", "red3"), min.cutoff = "q9", raster = F)

FeaturePlot(ductsub, features = c("Classical_CSY", "Basal_CSY"), raster = F,
            cols = c("beige", "blue3", "red3"), blend = TRUE, reduction = "dsub_umap")
```
